layout.footer: You’re receiving this because you applied through {{tenant}}’s candidate portal.

login_code.subject: Your sign-in code: {{code}}
login_code.heading: Your sign-in code
login_code.body: Use this code to sign in. It expires in {{minutes}} minutes. If you didn’t ask for it, you can ignore this email.

application_submitted.subject: We’ve received your application — {{jobTitle}}
application_submitted.heading: Application received
application_submitted.body: Thanks for applying for {{jobTitle}}. Your reference is {{reference}}. A person will review your application, and you can follow every step in the portal.

review_started.subject: Your application is being reviewed — {{jobTitle}}
review_started.heading: Your application is being reviewed
review_started.body: A recruiter has started reviewing your application for {{jobTitle}}.

assessment_invited.subject: Round 1 Assessment Ready — {{jobTitle}}
assessment_invited.heading: Your Round 1 Technical Assessment is ready
assessment_invited.body: Your scheduled Round 1 assessment “{{assessmentTitle}}” for {{jobTitle}} starts within 1 hour (before {{dueAt}}). Duration: {{durationMinutes}} minutes. Click below to complete your system check and start when your slot begins.

screening_invited.subject: Action Required: Quick Screening Test — {{jobTitle}}
screening_invited.heading: Complete your screening test
screening_invited.body: Thank you for applying for {{jobTitle}}! Your application is now In Review. Please complete the short screening questionnaire in the candidate portal so our AI & hiring team can evaluate your fit.

screening_on_hold.subject: Application Placed On Hold — {{jobTitle}}
screening_on_hold.heading: Your application is currently on hold

slot_booking_invited.subject: Congratulations! Select Your Round 1 Time Slot — {{jobTitle}}
slot_booking_invited.heading: You’ve been shortlisted! Book your Round 1 slot
slot_booking_invited.body: Great news! You cleared the screening evaluation for {{jobTitle}} and have been shortlisted for Round 1. Please select your preferred Round 1 time slot in the portal. Your personalized technical questions will be generated and emailed 1 hour before your scheduled slot.

assessment_submitted.subject: Assessment received — {{jobTitle}}
assessment_submitted.heading: Assessment received
assessment_submitted.body: Thanks — your assessment for {{jobTitle}} has been submitted. The hiring team will review it.

round2_invited.subject: Congratulations! Round 2 Technical Project Ready — {{jobTitle}}
round2_invited.heading: You’re invited to Round 2: Technical Project Assessment
round2_invited.body: Great news! You’ve passed Round 1 for {{jobTitle}}. Your personalized Round 2 technical project “{{projectTitle}}” is now ready in the candidate portal. Scheduled window: {{slotWindow}}. Duration: {{durationMinutes}} minutes.

round2_passed.subject: Congratulations! You Passed Round 2 — {{jobTitle}}
round2_passed.heading: Congratulations — Round 2 Cleared!
round2_passed.body: We’re thrilled to let you know that HR has approved your Round 2 technical project for {{jobTitle}}. You are advancing to Round 3 (HR Interview). We will notify you as soon as your interview slot is ready.

round2_rejected.subject: Application Update — Round 2 ({{jobTitle}})
round2_rejected.heading: Update on your Round 2 assessment
round2_rejected.body: Thank you for completing the Round 2 technical project for {{jobTitle}}. After careful review of your submission, the hiring team has decided not to move forward to the next round at this time.

round3_invited.subject: Round 3 HR Interview Invitation — {{jobTitle}}
round3_invited.heading: You’re invited to Round 3: Final HR Interview
round3_invited.body: Your Round 3 proctored HR interview for {{jobTitle}} is ready. Scheduled time: {{slotWindow}}. Please join through the candidate portal and complete the quick system check before starting.

interview_invited.subject: Please book your interview — {{jobTitle}}
interview_invited.heading: You’re invited to an interview
interview_invited.body: The hiring team would like to meet you for “{{roundTitle}}”. Choose a time that suits you in the portal.

interview_booked.subject: Interview confirmed — {{startsAt}}
interview_booked.heading: Interview confirmed
interview_booked.body: “{{roundTitle}}” is booked for {{startsAt}}. A calendar invite is attached. Join from the portal a few minutes before the start.

interview_rescheduled.subject: Interview time changed — {{startsAt}}
interview_rescheduled.heading: Interview time changed
interview_rescheduled.body: “{{roundTitle}}” is now booked for {{startsAt}}. An updated calendar invite is attached.

interview_completed.subject: Thanks for interviewing — {{jobTitle}}
interview_completed.heading: Thanks for your time
interview_completed.body: Your interview “{{roundTitle}}” is complete. We’ll let you know about next steps.

offer_sent.subject: You have an offer from {{tenant}}
offer_sent.heading: Congratulations — you have an offer
offer_sent.body: We’re delighted to offer you the role of {{jobTitle}}. Please review it and reply by {{respondBy}}.

offer_accepted.subject: Welcome to {{tenant}}
offer_accepted.heading: Welcome aboard
offer_accepted.body: Thanks for accepting your offer for {{jobTitle}}. Your next step is onboarding — upload a few documents in the portal.

offer_declined.subject: Offer declined — {{jobTitle}}
offer_declined.heading: We’ve recorded your decision
offer_declined.body: You’ve declined the offer for {{jobTitle}}. Thank you for your time with us.

onboarding_started.subject: Your onboarding checklist — {{jobTitle}}
onboarding_started.heading: Let’s get you ready
onboarding_started.body: Your onboarding checklist for {{jobTitle}} is ready in the portal.

onboarding_document_rejected.subject: Please re-upload — {{taskTitle}}
onboarding_document_rejected.heading: A document needs another look
onboarding_document_rejected.body: We couldn’t accept “{{taskTitle}}”. Note from the team: {{note}}

joining_details_shared.subject: Your first day — {{startDate}}
joining_details_shared.heading: Your first-day details
joining_details_shared.body: Your first day is {{startDate}} at {{location}}. Full details are in the portal.

application_closed.subject: An update on your application — {{jobTitle}}
application_closed.heading: An update on your application
application_closed.body: Thank you for your interest in {{jobTitle}}. After careful consideration, the team won’t be moving forward with your application this time.

hired.subject: Welcome to the team
hired.heading: Welcome to the team
hired.body: Everything’s ready for your first day as {{jobTitle}}.

staff_reschedule_request.subject: Reschedule request — {{candidateName}}
staff_reschedule_request.heading: A candidate asked for other times

staff_invited.subject: You’ve been added to {{tenant}} on Brutallyhired
staff_invited.heading: You’ve been added to the hiring team
staff_invited.body: Sign in with this email address to access {{tenant}}’s hiring workspace.
